effect_description_eng:
When you would play this card from your hand, if you have 10 or more cards in your trash, reduce the play cost by 8.
[On Play] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[All Turns] This Digimon can only digivolve into Digimon cards with [Lucemon] in their name.
